title: The repeats detector files a finding for the running ISO week, whose intake --status check can never pass
goal: bl_intake.repeats_detector reports only ISO weeks that have ended, so the story it files is about a closed week's count, and the intake --status check it gives the story can pass once a later closed week stays at or under REPEAT_THRESHOLD (or the story's check reads a measure work can change); today the fingerprint is the running week, whose committed call count only grows, so ST-mwtm7r7b, ST-evlez5mw and ST-52x5bpab (2026-W41 grep, tools.backlog, python) were dropped from SP-qzip6qar as unpassable.

run: import sys,datetime;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_intake;y,w,_=datetime.date.today().isocalendar();cur=f'{y}-W{w:02d}';f=[c.title for c in bl_intake.repeats_detector('.') if cur in c.title];print(cur,f);sys.exit(1 if f else 0)
